name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: Projects the caller can read, by slug. Every other tool takes a project slug.

name: get_brief
title: Get the project brief
description: The project's brief: its goal, domain, constraints and conventions, as Markdown with YAML front matter. Read it before drafting or claiming. Without revision, the current one; claims and jobs name the revision they run under.

revision.description: A brief revision; omitted, the current one.
revision.title: Revision

name: revise_brief
title: Revise the project brief
description: Write a new revision of the project's brief: the whole document, Markdown with YAML front matter holding at least title and goal (GET /api/schemas/brief). Only researchers write briefs; acting for one, you are recorded as the channel. expected_revision is the current revision, 0 for the first brief.

name: list_tracks
title: List tracks
description: A project's research tracks, by slug, optionally filtered by state.

name: get_track
title: Get a track
description: One track: its state, mode (agent or workflow), producer binding, workflow and revision.

name: track_history
title: List a track's events
description: A track's audit events (creation, updates, transitions), oldest first, with actor, via and reason.

before.description: Continue after this event sequence number.
before.title: Before

name: create_track
title: Create a track
description: Create a track from a track contract document (researchers).

name: update_track
title: Update a track
description: Change a track's title, description, producer binding, mode or workflow at an expected revision (researchers). Omitted fields keep their value; a producer, mode or workflow change needs a reason.

reason.description: Required when the producer binding, the mode or the workflow changes.
reason.title: Reason

name: transition_track
title: Pause, resume or archive a track
description: Move a track to another state with a track_transition contract document (researchers).

annotations.title: Pause, resume or archive a track

name: create_draft
title: Create a hypothesis draft
description: Create a hypothesis draft (researchers and the project's agents). Search for prior related work first. The draft waits for a researcher's review.

idempotency_key.description: Repeat a write with the same key to get its first result, not a duplicate.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

name: revise_draft
title: Revise a hypothesis draft
description: Replace a draft's document at its expected current revision. An agent may only revise the drafts it created.

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

name: list_hypotheses
title: List hypotheses
description: A project's hypotheses, newest first, filtered by state or track.

archived.description: true: only archived states; false: hide them. Ignored with `state`.
archived.title: Archived

name: get_hypothesis
title: Get a hypothesis
description: One hypothesis: its current document, relations, backlinks and reviews.

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

name: list_hypothesis_revisions
title: List a hypothesis's revisions
description: A hypothesis's draft revisions, oldest first, each with its document, author and via.

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

name: review_draft
title: Review a hypothesis draft
description: Approve, request a revision of, or decline a draft's exact revision, with a reason (researchers only; agents and other service accounts cannot).

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

name: claim_hypothesis
title: Claim a queued hypothesis
description: Claim a queued hypothesis (a given number, or the next one, optionally in a track) and receive an attempt with a lease token and generation. Heartbeat before the lease expires. Agents and researchers claim only hypotheses of `agent`-mode tracks; `workflow` tracks are claimed only by an experimenter (a Cannery Row runner).

mode.description: Claim only in tracks of this mode. Only an `experimenter` service account (a Cannery Row runner) claims in `workflow` mode, and only there; agents and researchers claim in `agent` mode. Omitted, the caller's mode applies.

name: list_attempts
title: List attempts
description: A project's attempts, most recently claimed first.

name: get_attempt
title: Get an attempt
description: One attempt: state, artifacts, failures and its claimed result sheet.

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

sequence.description: Attempt sequence within the hypothesis (#12.3 is 3).
sequence.title: Sequence

name: heartbeat_attempt
title: Extend an attempt's lease
description: Extend the claimed attempt's lease.

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

sequence.description: Attempt sequence within the hypothesis (#12.3 is 3).
sequence.title: Sequence

lease_token.description: The lease token the claim returned.
lease_token.title: Lease Token

lease_generation.description: The lease generation the claim returned.
lease_generation.title: Lease Generation

name: release_attempt
title: Give up an attempt
description: Give up the claimed attempt with a reason. It fails and a researcher decides whether to retry. Only an experimenter sends a failure `code`, `step` and `logs`.

number.description: Hypothesis number within the project (#12 is 12).
number.title: Number

sequence.description: Attempt sequence within the hypothesis (#12.3 is 3).

lease_token.title: Lease Token

lease_generation.description: The lease generation the claim returned.
lease_generation.title: Lease Generation

code.description: An experimenter only, and required from it: why the run failed. Every code is a failure of the run, retried automatically while the science revision's `max_auto_retries` allows, then reviewed (docs/contracts.md).

step.description: An experimenter only: the failing step of the workflow.
step.title: Step

logs.description: An experimenter only: the failing run's logs, verified uploads of this attempt, kept as the failure's log references.
logs.title: Logs

description: Record the attempt's artifact manifest; every object must be a verified upload. Returns the manifest reference the claimed result sheet cites.

description: Record a researcher's reasoned decision on a pending result or failure review case; a draft case is decided with review_draft instead. Only people with the researcher role may; agent, tester and evaluator tokens are refused.
